findings.explanation: The detailedImplementation section contains duplicate steps 1-4 with generic HEC/API text and mentions DMA acceleration when no data models are used.
findings.quote:
Step 1 — Configure data collection

Install and configure the add-on referenced in the app field (JMX, broker metrics — Universal Forwarder (Splunkbase 617)). Enable the modular input or HEC token that writes sourcetype=kafka:broker into kafka.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the duplicated step block and spurious DMA mention, focusing on Kafka JMX inputs via Splunk Connect for Kafka (Splunkbase 3862) or TA-jmx.

summary: Core SPL logic for Kafka broker health is sound, but implementation steps are duplicated with irrelevant generic boilerplate and DMA references.
